body.name: \(\operatorname{Dec}_n\) and \(\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: For each \(b\in\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\), define \(\operatorname{Dec}_n(b)\) as the set of all full laws \(Q\in\mathcal M\) whose stratum masses, order-\(K_n\) Taylor--Legendre coefficients of their latent-density and marked-density transforms, positive order-\(2K_n\) error quadratures, second-moment tail components, and certified analytic remainders lie in the corresponding coordinate and remainder intervals of \(b\), and whose exact paired-channel discrepancy satisfies the outward constraint interval recorded by \(b\). Set \(\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}=\bigcup_{b\in\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}}\operatorname{Dec}_n(b)\subseteq\mathcal M\).
